description: Search the OpenTopography catalog for high-resolution LiDAR point cloud datasets covering a specified bounding box. LiDAR datasets provide centimetre-to-metre resolution 3D terrain data, primarily from USGS 3DEP surveys across the US. Returns dataset name, OpenTopography ID, DOI URL, acquisition date, spatial coverage bounds, and description. Essential for discovering available high-resolution terrain data before requesting downloads. Source: OpenTopography catalog, CC BY 4.0, free registration (5K req/day).

max_lat.description: Northern boundary of search area in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

max_lon.description: Eastern boundary of search area in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

min_lat.description: Southern boundary of search area in decimal degrees (-90 to 90)

min_lon.description: Western boundary of search area in decimal degrees (-180 to 180)

name: opentopo.catalog.lidar

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: OpenTopography LiDAR Dataset Catalog
